[SWS_CRYPT_03304]
{DRAFT}
Key agreement - optional call parameters
⌈
The
interface
ara::crypto::cryp::KeyAgreementPrivateCtx::AgreeKey
shall
only process the optionally provided parameters
ara::crypto::ReadOnlyMemRe-
gion Salt
and
ara::crypto::ReadOnlyMemRegion
ctxLabel, if required by the
configured
ara::crypto::CryptoAlgId
of this context. If such parameters are re-
quired, but not provided, an empty value shall be used.
⌋
(RS_CRYPTO_02105)
